items.reason: Four registered EXPERIMENTAL arms (Part I, II, III, IV A), none working as a control; manual R8 defines 'no' as more than one arm but none a control, and 'not_applicable' only for single-arm trials.

The official title states the study evaluates 'Pharmacodynamics ... of RO7428731' and the summary lists pharmacodynamics (PD) as an objective, i.e. a PD measurement for the candidate; W7 reserves 'unclear' for a biomarker endpoint not linked to the candidate. No PD outcome or sample type is registered, so some doubt remains.

note: EGFRvIII match rests on the design ('Glioblastoma Expressing Mutant Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor Variant III', exclusion of prior anti-EGFRvIII agents); the record never states RO7428731's target, but both coders agree and it is not queued. MGMT role (enrichment vs eligibility) is a priority-3 item: unmethylated status is required for Part II only, so enrichment fits better.
